title: How to file GSTR-4 yourself

sections.heading: Before you start
points: First, file **all your CMP-08 forms** of the year.
Look at the list of papers on this page. Tick each one when you have it.
Keep your GST username, password and phone ready. You will get an OTP on the phone.

sections.heading: Steps
steps: Open the GST portal and log in.
Pick the **year**. Then click **GSTR-4 (Annual return)** and **Prepare online**.
The portal shows your sales and tax from your CMP-08 forms. Check them.
Write everything you **bought** in the year. The portal calls this "inward supplies". Add bills from **all** sellers, with a GST number or without one.
If you must pay anything (or a late fee), pay it from your **GST cash** on the portal (called "electronic cash ledger").
Click **Preview** and check everything once more.
Click **File**. Use the OTP sent to your phone (EVC), or your digital signature (DSC) if you have one.
Download the receipt. It has a number called **ARN**. Keep it safe.

sections.heading: After filing
points: Come back to this page and click **Mark as filed**.
Upload the receipt (a PDF or a photo). Then you and your CA can always find it.
The app reads the receipt. If it matches, the app shows "Filed–verified".

sections.heading: Common mistakes
points: Filing GSTR-4 before all your CMP-08 forms are filed.
Forgetting things bought from sellers who have **no** GST number.
